title: Cross-model permutation instability
research_question: How does control-adjusted answer-order instability vary across model families and scales on NetOps MCQA tasks?
scientific_gap: Benchmark accuracy obscures item-level decision churn.
unit_of_analysis: paired semantic answer per question and model

hypotheses.falsification_condition: Clustered interval includes zero and paired test is non-significant.
hypotheses.analysis_method: Exact paired test plus task-cluster bootstrap

design_summary: Uses unchanged repeat, fixed transformation manifest, disjoint confirmatory sample, and task-cluster-aware uncertainty.

title: Structured reasoning mitigation
research_question: Can option-independent structured reasoning reduce answer-order instability without materially degrading accuracy?
scientific_gap: Diagnosis-only studies do not provide an operational mitigation.
unit_of_analysis: paired semantic answer per question and inference method
primary_outcome: difference in excess disagreement between methods

hypotheses.statement: Structured reasoning reduces excess disagreement versus direct MCQA.
hypotheses.falsification_condition: Clustered interval includes zero or favours direct MCQA.

hypotheses.statement: Structured reasoning preserves accuracy within a non-inferiority margin.

expected_contribution: A tested inference-time mitigation for reliable NetOps decisions.
failure_conditions: mitigation increases cost without reducing instability
design_summary: Uses unchanged repeat, fixed transformation manifest, disjoint confirmatory sample, and task-cluster-aware uncertainty. Includes a preregistered accuracy non-inferiority margin.

title: Semantics-preserving transformation suite
research_question: Which semantics-preserving presentation transformations most strongly alter LLM NetOps decisions?
scientific_gap: Answer permutation is only one form of irrelevant presentation change.
unit_of_analysis: paired semantic answer per question and transformation

hypotheses.statement: At least one transformation yields positive excess disagreement.
hypotheses.falsification_condition: Multiplicity-adjusted intervals include zero for all transformations.

failure_conditions: transformations cannot be validated as meaning-preserving
design_summary: Uses unchanged repeat, fixed transformation manifest, disjoint confirmatory sample, and task-cluster-aware uncertainty. Includes identity controls and multiplicity correction.

title: Task-complexity moderation
research_question: Do constraint density and competing objectives moderate transformation-induced NetOps decision instability?
scientific_gap: Mechanisms and task-level moderators remain unexplained.

hypotheses.statement: Higher deterministic complexity predicts greater excess disagreement.
hypotheses.falsification_condition: Interval includes zero or coefficient is non-positive.

expected_contribution: Mechanistic evidence on when instability occurs.
design_summary: Uses unchanged repeat, fixed transformation manifest, disjoint confirmatory sample, and task-cluster-aware uncertainty. Uses preregistered deterministic feature extraction.

title: Permutation ensemble mitigation
research_question: Can semantic voting over fixed option permutations improve decision stability and calibration?
scientific_gap: Permutation ensembles are plausible but their cost-benefit is unclear.

hypotheses.statement: Permutation voting reduces excess disagreement versus one-pass answering.

expected_contribution: A robustness wrapper with explicit cost trade-offs.
design_summary: Uses unchanged repeat, fixed transformation manifest, disjoint confirmatory sample, and task-cluster-aware uncertainty. Uses preregistered semantic voting.
